content: मारिषः .²1 A respectable, worthy or venerable man, (used in dramas in the <ab>voc.</ab> as a respectful mode of address by the Sūtradhāra to one of the principal actors; see <ls>U. 1</ls>; <ls>Māl. 1.</ls>); शूरो मातामहः कच्चित् स्वस्त्यास्ते वाऽथ मारिषः <ls>Bhāg. 1. 14. 26</ls>. .²2 Amaranthus Oleraceus (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>तांदुळजा</ns>).
